# Third Party Software

This directory is warehouses external 3rd party software necessary for building, maintaining, or running the software in this project.

## Index

| Name/Identifier | Source Location | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

## Standards

- 3rd party software must be licensable under MIT or similar licenses.
- Not commercial even if made available for personal or non-business use.
- Actively maintained with updates to the project in the last three months
- Documented
- Source code is provided via github or gitlab or similarly public and secure repository
- Covered by tests
- Has active community of contributors beyond the original author(s)
- Buildable on multiple moder systems: macOS, linux (x86, x65, arm64), Windows (10 and later).
- Source is provided via a language referenced in this project's `STANDARDS.md` file.
